spellbook_map.scope: 30 units of P. Leiden I 384 / PGM XII / PDM XII

book_of_dead_inverse.selection_warning: These BD nodes were already selected in an earlier Osiris-restoration inverse pilot and therefore are confirmatory, not a fresh blind discovery.

pgm_uniform_30_unit_pass.representation_rule: Use only the same structural fields available for every unit: title_function and class. Do not let Unit 17 win because it has richer prior annotation.
pgm_uniform_30_unit_pass.reason: No unit reaches AURA's admission threshold from uniform metadata.

highest_candidates.title: Interpretations: secret names / substitutions for ritual materials
highest_candidates.reason: Material-code aliasing resembles label-vs-referent superficially, but AURA explicitly rejects aliasing as a strong identity match unless local authority/rightful-source semantics are present.

highest_candidates.title: To gain favour and friendship forever
highest_candidates.reason: Friendship is not the Three Kings non-deletion/family-reunion structure.

highest_candidates.title: Myth of the Sun's Eye
highest_candidates.reason: Sun imagery alone was pre-rejected by AURA as decorative.

highest_candidates.title: Ring to cause praise / favour
highest_candidates.reason: Ring alone has no identity-restoration function.

highest_candidates.title: To make a tincture of gold
highest_candidates.reason: Gold alone was pre-rejected by AURA as decorative.

highest_candidates.title: A ring; consecrated ring for every operation and success
highest_candidates.reason: Universal-success ring function does not itself match Osiris identity/restoration, Set chaos-order, Kem non-possession or Three Kings family logic.

highest_candidates.title: A little ring for success, favour and victory
highest_candidates.reason: Ring/success/victory is not the frozen narrative function.

negative_controls_observed: PDM xii.119-134 / PGM XII.469-473 separation/fetching context
pgm_uniform_30_unit_pass.negative_control_interpretation: The corpus contains many explicit separation units, so family-reunion language must not be inferred merely because the wider manuscript is Egyptian or magical.

pgm_unit17_enriched_audit.result: The prior visual/name co-occurrence remains interesting as a creative resonance, but under the frozen AURA plan it is not an admitted match to the current Osiris-return / Set-order / Kem-kindness narrative mechanics.

book_of_dead_confirmatory_pass.why: The seven nodes were previously selected specifically while investigating Osiris restoration, body identity, containers and loss. Their later agreement with the story cannot be treated as an unbiased surprise.

nodes.match: Direct Osiris + body-part identity; registry notes explicitly that the phallus is that of Osiris.
Direct Osiris + raising/stabilization after restoration; gold djed is contextual, not the reason for the strong score.
Bones/limbs united and heart placed back in the body: strong restoration function but no deity-name requirement is satisfied by the stored node description itself.
Osiris and guarded body-content/container motif; not a direct RETURN_TO_SOURCE formula.
Osiris-in-chest/container motif without explicit identity restoration.
Persistence/survival after restoration, but too generic to carry the narrative identity claim alone.
Osirian burial context only; no matching restoration/identity function.

book_of_dead_confirmatory_pass.strongest_structural_chain: BD42 BODY_PART_IDENTITY -> BD151 REASSEMBLY -> BD155 RAISE/STABILIZE_OSIRIS
book_of_dead_confirmatory_pass.chain_boundary: This ordering is JANUS's modern inverse-dependency construction, not a claim that the ancient Book of the Dead presents these chapters as one continuous spell or in this sequence.

verdict.new_claim_unlocked: The strongest source-grounded bridge remains the ancient Osirian identity/reassembly/raising motif. The broader modern Three Kings, Kem, Mirror of Set and AntiDup architecture is not recovered from the spellbook by this pass.

next_gate.name: AURA_PRESPECIFIED_FULL_TEXT_CORPUS_CONTROL
next_gate.requirement: If a stronger test is desired, freeze the same AURA rules and apply them to uniformly represented full ancient text units rather than mixing coarse titles with one richly annotated spell.
preferred_controls: all PGM/PDM spell units represented at the same textual depth
held-out Egyptian magical formularies not used to design the story vector
matched Osiris-name texts with unrelated functions
